description: Render a saved design to a print file (members only). Queues a job — the file is produced by a headless renderer in ~15–60 s — and returns a jobId; poll get_export for the download link. output 'png' is the Original full-resolution PNG (600 DPI), 'pdf' its design-size PDF. Needs an API key with export on a membership account.
name: export_design
